stem: A handoff contains an unresolved inventory discrepancy and an equipment alarm. What should it make clear?
choices: Only which worker caused the problems
The exact affected identities/assets, factual status, controls taken, who was notified, and next required actions
Only that management has been told
Only the total number of completed tasks
rationale: Open issues need precise status, identity, notification and next-action information so the next shift can continue safely.
